installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Banana Shooter Dedicated Server install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/installers:debian'
#
# The server app (2406780) can't be downloaded anonymously, so a Steam account that owns Banana Shooter is required.

if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "Steam user is not set. Banana Shooter needs a Steam account that owns the game.\n"
    exit 1
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" "${STEAM_AUTH}" +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) validate +quit

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/bsds ]]; then
    echo -e "Server files are missing, check the steamcmd output above.\n"
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/bsds

# The server logs on to Steam as the game (1949740), not the server app.
echo 1949740 > /mnt/server/steam_appid.txt

## default config, kept on reinstall
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Servers/${SERVER}
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/Servers/${SERVER}/Config.json ]]; then
cat > /mnt/server/Servers/${SERVER}/Config.json <<CONFIG
{
  "Server": {
    "Login_Token": "",
    "VAC_Secure": true,
    "DLC_Only": false,
    "Enable_Update_Restart": true
  },
  "Browser": {
    "Server_Name": "Banana Shooter",
    "Description_Short": ""
  },
  "Game": {
    "Random_Map": false,
    "Random_GameMode": false,
    "Minimal_Player_Amount": 2,
    "Server_Type": 1
  }
}
CONFIG
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
